## Personality

Curious, muddy and full of treasure. He thinks every shiny thing is a lost crown.

## Story

Robin combs the riverbank at low water for things people have dropped, and sells the best to the curio dealer. He found an old badge with a seal no one recognises and keeps it under his pillow.
